programme.title: The Tioga Kid
programme.desc: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

programme.title: Check Your Guns
programme.desc: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad).

programme.title: Oath of Vengeance
programme.desc: Cowhands Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) open a general store together in a town embroiled in a battle between ranchers and farmers. Cattleman Dale Kirby (Mady Lawrence) believes the farmers have been stealing cattle, forcing him to borrow from crooked lender Steve Kinney (Jack Ingram). In truth, however, it is Kinney himself who is behind the cattle thefts. When Billy attempts to mediate, he and Fuzzy find themselves threatened by Kinney.

programme.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

programme.title: Overland Riders
programme.desc: Cowboy Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is riding in a stagecoach with young Jean (Patti McCarty), on his way to a business deal with her father. The coach is attacked by bandits, but luckily Fuzzy's buddy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) is in the vicinity, and he comes to the rescue, fending off the outlaws. Billy helps Jean get back home, only to learn that the bandits he's just thwarted have killed her father and pinned the crime on Fuzzy. Billy then must go after the real murderers.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose.

programme.title: Man From Oklahoma
programme.desc: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress.

programme.title: Susanna Pass
programme.desc: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps.

programme.title: Twilight in the Sierras
programme.desc: Parole officer Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) visits his kindhearted friend Judge Wiggins (Edward Keane) at his home for rehabilitated ex-convicts. Behind the judge's back, foreman Matt Brunner (George Meeker) has been running a counterfeiting ring with the unwilling help of former prisoner Ricardo Chavez (Russ Vincent). An accident during a lion hunt causes Deputy Sheriff Pat Callahan (Dale Evans) to arrest Roy for murder, while Brunner's henchmen kidnap Chavez's visiting sister (Estelita Rodriguez).

programme.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
programme.desc: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Three excitement-craving friends get more than they bargained for when they steal a hit woman's automobile.

programme.title: Niagara Niagara
programme.desc: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral.

programme.title: Premium
programme.desc: Reginald "Cool" Coolidge is an actor hoping for his big break away from stereotypical black roles. When his ex-fiancée, Charli, pulls in to the gas station where he works, Cool realizes that he still loves her after three years apart. But there is one problem: Charli's wedding to another man is only 36 hours away. Desperate to win her back, Cool uses his talents as an actor to convince Charli that she is choosing the wrong man.

programme.title: Dead Birds
programme.desc: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted.

programme.title: The Navajo Kid
programme.desc: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large.

programme.title: Ambush Trail
programme.desc: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Range Beyond the Blue
programme.desc: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation.

programme.title: Border Feud
programme.desc: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: The Set Up
programme.desc: Charlie Thorpe is a brilliant security expert and convicted burglar. After being released from prison, Charlie resolves to turn his life around and takes a straight job designing the security for a newly renovated bank. However, his old criminal life catches up with him when his former prison mate, Kliff, kidnaps his new girlfriend, Gina. Charlie is left with few options when Kliff blackmails him into breaking into the bank.

programme.title: The Silver Strand
programme.desc: A Navy wife (Nicollette Sheridan) is caught between her SEAL-commander husband and her lover, a brash recruit (Gil Bellows).

programme.title: Riders to the Stars
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Stanton (William Lundigan) and Dr. Jerry Lockwood (Richard Carlson) are two daring young scientists who put their lives on the line to explore the universe. Seeking to discover a metal better suited to space travel, these pioneers launch into outer space to retrieve a meteorite. But, after fellow astronaut Walter Gordon (Robert Karnes) is violently killed when attempting to wrangle an enormous meteor, Lockwood panics, leaving Stanton to complete the mission on his own.

programme.title: Five Steps to Danger
programme.desc: Hitchhiking on a deserted New Mexico road after his car breaks down, John Emmett (Sterling Hayden) gets picked up by Ann Nicholson (Ruth Roman), who is in a rush to reach Santa Fe, N.M. The distraught Ann is being pursued by psychiatrist Frederick Simmons (Werner Klemperer), who has been treating her in Los Angeles since she had a nervous breakdown, but she tells John that she is in possession of nuclear secrets that she must deliver to Dr. Reinhart Kissel (Karl Lindt) at a Santa Fe university.

programme.title: China Doll
programme.desc: Pilot Cliff Brandon (Victor Mature) flies missions from China in support of troops in the Pacific Theater, but is depressed by his situation and takes to excessive drinking. After one late-night binge, he finds that a young woman named Shu-Jen (Li Hua Li) has been either sold or betrothed to him. Brandon is reluctant to acknowledge the relationship, but he finds himself increasingly eager to return to Shu-Jen. When she becomes pregnant, his priorities change dramatically.

programme.title: The Tender
programme.desc: After his wife overdoses and dies, Bobby (John Travolta) raises his daughter (Ellie Raab) by himself in Chicago, while she spends her time nursing a dog back to health. Finding a job through his brother-in-law, Cissy (Tito Larriva), Bobby earns money working for the Mafia. However, Cissy, who blames Bobby for his sister's death, sets him up as a fall guy. Bobby manages to flee with his daughter, but the Mafia is right behind -- and so is the dog, who remains loyal to the girl.

However, his old criminal life catches up with him when his former prison mate, Kliff, kidnaps his new girlfriend, Gina. Charlie is left with few options when Kliff blackmails him into breaking into the bank.

programme.title: The Silver Strand

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac
programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Coming home at the end of World War I, Matt Brady (John Payne), the black-sheep brother of big-city political boss Tim Brady (Roy Roberts), is a loose cannon who gets into drunken fights and impulsively marries a total stranger, the plain but kind-hearted Lorry (Gloria McGhee). Taking over his brother's political machine after Tim's sudden death, Matt becomes powerful and extremely wealthy, but his corrupt dealings with a local gangster (Robin Morse) threaten to destroy everything he has.

programme.title: Cloudburst
programme.desc: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief?

programme.title: Hell Bound
programme.desc: A gangster's consort (June Blair) and an ambulance driver (Stuart Whitman) become involved in a villain's (John Russell) plan to steal surplus war drugs.

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Chicago Confidential
programme.desc: A state's attorney (Brian Keith) nails a union leader (Dick Foran) for murder, then learns it was part of a mob frame-up.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror
programme.desc: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

programme.title: The Last Mile
programme.desc: A killer (Mickey Rooney) gets desperate with eight others on death row, then makes his move.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Alias John Preston
programme.desc: A small-town young man (Christopher Lee) rises in social standing, haunted by nightmares of murder.

programme.title: Curse of the Faceless Man
programme.desc: A scientist's (Richard Anderson) girlfriend (Elaine Edwards) is kidnapped by a stony Etruscan gladiator-slave found near Pompeii.

programme.title: The Black Tent
programme.desc: An Englishman (Donald Sinden) learns his army brother (Anthony Steel) married a Bedouin (Anna-Maria Sandri) and fought the Nazis as a guerrilla.

programme.title: The Big Boodle
programme.desc: Cuban crooks and police chase a casino card dealer (Errol Flynn) for counterfeit pesos and plates.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him.

programme.title: Beachhead
programme.desc: During World War II, four Marines land on a Pacific island to execute the rescue of French planter Bouchard (Eduard Franz) and his daughter, Nina (Mary Murphy). With Japanese soldiers hidden throughout the dense jungle landscape, the Marines face a daunting trek to reach their target and must endure even greater danger on the return trip with the two French citizens. In the end, one of the Marines, Burke (Tony Curtis), carries the responsibility of getting everyone to safety.

programme.title: Ten Seconds to Hell
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, six German soldiers return to Berlin and form a bomb disposal unit. Defusing bombs is extremely risky business, so every week the group contributes to a fund that will go to the last man standing. Only Karl Wirtz and Eric Koertner are left, and their once solid friendship is starting to crack. Adding to the tension is their rivalry over a local woman and one last job that could change everything.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: Kings Go Forth
programme.desc: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: Because final peace negotiations are bogged down in political maneuvering, U.S. soldiers, led by Lt. Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck), are forced to assault entrenched Chinese troops. The site of battle is Pork Chop Hill, a daunting, desolate climb that gives the communist forces a clear advantage. Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for back up, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat.

programme.title: The Secret Invasion
programme.desc: When the Allies need expendable soldiers for a highly dangerous mission, they offer pardons to a group of criminals in exchange for their participation. Led by the brooding Maj. Richard Mace (Stewart Granger), the motley crew, including explosives expert Terence Scanlon (Mickey Rooney) and scheming tough guy Roberto Rocca (Raf Vallone), sets out to extract a defecting Italian general held captive in a Nazi-controlled area. As they get farther into German territory, the casualties start to rise.

programme.title: A Prayer for the Dying
programme.desc: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. Now, Fallon wants out. He's through killing for the cause, but in order to secure safe passage to the U.S., he'll have to take one more job: eliminating rival terrorist Krasko (Stanley Beard). Unfortunately, a priest (Bob Hoskins) complicates matters by witnessing the hit, but Fallon believes he knows how to keep him silent.

programme.title: The File of the Golden Goose
programme.desc: A U.S. agent (Yul Brynner) and a Scotland Yard man (Edward Woodward) infiltrate a forgery ring run by someone called the Owl.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: A Hole in the Head
programme.desc: Based on Arnold Schulman's Broadway play of the same name, this comedy finds widower Tony Manetta (Frank Sinatra) struggling to own and operate a Miami hotel. Irresponsible in both business and romance, Tony is dedicated to his young son, Ally (Eddie Hodges), though he butts heads with his own brother, Mario (Edward G. Robinson). programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

programme.title: The Sharkfighters
programme.desc: Navy pilot Ben Staves (Victor Mature) arrives at a research facility on a small Caribbean island to help develop a shark repellent for use by sailors and downed airmen. Partnered with scientists Leonard Evans (Philip Coolidge) and Harold Duncan (James Olson), Staves provides valuable information about his own time stranded in the ocean. But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results.

programme.title: Time Limit
programme.desc: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. Anthony Turnbull (Cary Grant) to help the Spanish recapture it. When he arrives in Spain, Turnbull finds the cannon secured by Spanish rebels. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.title: Violent Playground
programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons.

programme.title: The 7th Dawn
programme.desc: After World War II, Ferris (William Holden) remains in Malaya and becomes a successful businessman. He enjoys a quiet existence with his Malayan girlfriend, Dhana (Capucine), although a politician's daughter named Candace (Susannah York) also fancies him. Soon, Ferris encounters a man named Ng (Tetsuro Tamba), who served with him during the war and is now a communist committed to revolution for the guerillas. After Dhana is arrested, Ferris makes a deal to track down Ng in order to save her.

programme.title: Shake Hands With the Devil
programme.desc: In 1921, Kerry O'Shea (Don Murray), an American medical student living in Ireland, learns that his esteemed professor, Sean Lenihan (James Cagney), is also a leader in Ireland's rebel army. Even though Kerry's father and roommate have both been killed by British troops, he refuses to join the Irish rebellion. However, after Kerry is unjustly imprisoned and tortured by the British "Black and Tans" special forces, he fully commits himself to the cause of Irish freedom.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo (Frank Silvera), who has eyes for his employee. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. programme.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
programme.desc: J. Pierpont Finch is a lowly window cleaner with dreams of making it big in the business world. After finding a copy of the book "How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying," Finch decides to apply the tactics in the book to his own life. Soon, he's working as a mail-room clerk at the World Wide Wicket Company and quickly fighting his way up the corporate ladder with relative ease in this quirky musical based on the hit Broadway production.

programme.title: The Quiet American
programme.desc: During the 1950s, Thomas Fowler is a British journalist stationed in Vietnam to cover the growing unrest. While in the country, he begins an extramarital affair with a beautiful young Vietnamese woman, Phuong. However, their romance is interrupted by Alden Pyle, an idealistic American economist in Vietnam on an aid mission. When Pyle proposes to Phuong, Fowler accuses him of secretly dealing weapons.

programme.title: Trapeze
programme.desc: Mike Ribble (Burt Lancaster) is a hard-drinking tent pitcher. His career as a famous trapeze artist ended years ago after attempting a triple somersault gave him a permanent limp. programme.desc: After leaving his wife, lawyer Jerry Ryan (Robert Mitchum) moves from Omaha, Neb., to New York City to start a new life. programme.title: Never on Sunday
programme.desc: Free spirit and prostitute Ilya (Melina Mercouri) lives in a Greek port city. Open and amiable, she makes friends often and easily. She encounters Homer Thrace (Jules Dassin), a vacationing American who is obsessed with ancient Greek culture. Homer feels that modern Greece is a shadow of its former self, and he believes that Ilya is a prime example of contemporary decadence. He makes it his goal to amend Ilya's easygoing ways, but she has stronger principles than Homer expected.

programme.title: The Knack... and How to Get It
programme.desc: Desperate to improve his luck with women, London schoolteacher Colin (Michael Crawford) enlists his artist roommate, Tom (Donal Donnelly), to help drag a brass bed back to their flat. Along the way they meet Nancy (Rita Tushingham), a new girl in town, who follows them home. There they encounter Tolen (Ray Brooks), the third roommate and a consummate lady-killer. He tries to help Colin seduce Nancy, but ends up whisking her away on his motorcycle instead, and Colin is determined to get her back.

programme.title: The First Time
programme.desc: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them.

programme.title: Namu, the Killer Whale
programme.desc: After fishermen off the coast of Washington state slay a killer whale, the dead animal's mate founders in the coastal waters. Marine biologist Hank Donner (Robert Lansing) finds the surviving whale and forges a bond with the animal while documenting his scientific observations. Though some believe killer whales are vicious, local woman Kate Rand (Lee Meriwether) and her young daughter, Lisa (Robin Mattson), warm to Hank's new pal, even as fishermen state their plans to kill the whale.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of Bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme.

programme.title: Stolen Hours
programme.desc: Laura (Susan Hayward), an American heiress in London, is a party girl living it up, in denial of her serious illness. She rebuffs the concerns of her ex-lover (Edward Judd) and keeps her health a secret from her sister (Diane Baker). Eventually, John (Michael Craig), a handsome doctor, demands she get treatment, and Laura finally listens. Doctor and patient fall in love and move to a house on the Cornish coast. In her dying days, the restless heiress searches for humility, happiness and peace.

programme.title: Adventures of Kitty O'Day
programme.desc: Kitty O'Day (Jean Parker) is a switchboard operator at a busy hotel where her boyfriend, Johnny (Peter Cookson), also works. Suspicious about some strange noises, she sends Johnny to her employer's apartment, where Johnny finds the boss has been murdered. Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew.

programme.title: Ladybug, Ladybug
programme.desc: The teachers and students of a countryside elementary school are thrown into a panic when an air raid siren goes off, warning them of an imminent nuclear attack. They are unaware that it has gone off by mistake, and separate the children into groups -- one of which is headed by the anxious Mrs. Andrews (Nancy Marchand) -- to take them home. Harriet (Alice Playten) invites her classmates into her family's bomb shelter, but tragedy strikes when she won't allow one of her classmates to enter.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Blind Rage
programme.desc: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

programme.title: Article 99
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous "Article 99," a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones
programme.desc: Two men (Robert Urich, Carl Weathers) of different races, who loathe each other, escape from a chain gang shackled together.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: Live: Get Up
programme.desc: ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Hudson Square in Lower Manhattan, a modern media hub for ESPN and The Walt Disney Company's New York-based teams. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show.

programme.title: Live: MLB Tonight
programme.desc: When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, "MLB Tonight" presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster that includes former players Eric Byrnes, Al Leiter, Dan Plesac, Billy Ripken and Mike Lowell, and inside information men Tom Verducci, Jon Heyman, Peter Gammons and Ken Rosenthal. Greg Amsinger, Brian Kenny and Matt Vasgersian are among the hosts.

Meanwhile, Alonzo falls in love with another performer, Nanon (Joan Crawford), who has a phobia against being touched by a man. When Absalon's son returns home and is attracted to Anne, it's a matter of time before her family destiny catches up with her.

programme.title: Ordet

Youngest son Anders (Cay Kristiansen) shares his father's religion, but eldest son Mikkel (Emil Hass Christensen) has lost his faith, while middle child Johannes (Preben Lerdorff Rye) has become delusional and proclaims that he is Jesus Christ himself. When Mikkel's wife, Inger (Birgitte Federspiel) goes into a difficult childbirth, everyone's beliefs are put to the test.

programme.title: Gold Rush Maisie

She is forced to hitchhike into town, only to discover that the job's already been taken. On the upside, Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside the area and decides to go into business with the Davises, a family of poor prospectors, as well as Bill Anders (Lee Bowman), a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold.

programme.title: Maisie Gets Her Man
programme.desc: Chicago showgirl Maisie Ravier (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and begins a job working for Pappy (Allen Jenkins), a decent building manager. When she ends up getting them both fired, she lands a new position as an assistant to an aspiring comedian, Hap (Red Skelton). Hap's failings on stage, however, leave them in need of another job: working for a con man (Lloyd Corrigan) who bottles tap water. Eventually, Maisie and Hap fall for each other, but he still has a fiancée back home.

programme.title: The Barbarian

programme.title: When Ladies Meet
programme.desc: Reporter Jimmie Lee (Robert Montgomery) suspects his long-time girlfriend, successful novelist Mary Howard (Myrna Loy), of having a romance with her married publisher, Rogers Woodruf (Frank Morgan). While Mary works on her latest novel -- about a married woman allowing her husband to desert her for his mistress -- Jimmie meets Woodruf's wife, Clare (Ann Harding). Realizing she is unaware of her husband's affair, he convinces Clare to meet Mary while pretending to be his new girlfriend.

programme.title: Penthouse
programme.desc: After lawyer Jackson Durant (Warner Baxter) successfully defends racketeer Tony Gazotti (Nat Pendleton), Durant's fiancée, Sue (Martha Sleeper), leaves him. However, she soon needs his help when her new beau, Tom (Phillips Holmes), is accused of killing his old girlfriend (Mae Clarke). Durant takes the case, and, with the help of Gazotti and Gertie (Myrna Loy), the victim's roommate, he determines that crime boss Jim Crelliman (C. Henry Gordon) played a role in the murder.

programme.title: Night Flight
programme.desc: Pilots risk their lives by flying in dangerous weather through the Andes Mountains to deliver medicine to Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: The Prizefighter and the Lady
programme.desc: Steve (real-life boxer Max Baer) is a brash bartender whose knock-out power is discovered by the Professor (Walter Huston), an alcoholic ex-fight trainer. Working together, they find success in the ring, and Steve begins a whirlwind romance with the sultry Belle (Myrna Loy), a gangster's moll who hastily leaves her man to marry him. Steve's infidelity brings discord to their marriage, but he'll have to overcome these distractions if he's going to succeed in his heavyweight title fight.

programme.title: Men in White
programme.desc: Pressured by long hours filled with life-and-death decisions, medical intern George Ferguson (Clark Gable) grows increasingly exhausted and unsure about his career. After a night call forces him to break another date with fiancée Laura Hudson (Myrna Loy), George takes comfort with nursing student Barbara Dennin (Elizabeth Allan) -- unaware that his mentor, Dr. Hochberg (Jean Hersholt), knows of the liaison. Later, when confronted by Barbara's botched abortion, George must decide his future.

programme.title: Stamboul Quest

As a German agent during World War I, Annemarie travels to Constantinople to gather information on a Turkish military official. Things go smoothly until she encounters an American medical student named Douglas (George Brent) while on her way to the Middle East. As the spy and the student fall in love, deadly consequences result.

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Fred, Al and Homer are three World War II veterans facing difficulties as they re-enter civilian life. Fred (Dana Andrews) is a war hero who, unable to compete with more highly skilled workers, has to return to his low-wage soda jerk job. Bank executive Al (Fredric March) gets into trouble for offering favorable loans to veterans. After losing both hands in the war, Homer (Harold Russell) returns to his loving fiancée, but must struggle to adjust.

programme.title: The Red Pony

Capturing Tom's admiration, however, is the hired ranch hand, Billy Buck, a venerable horse expert. When his father gives him a pony as a gift, Tom learns the importance of responsibility, but also has to face the pain of loss.

programme.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
programme.desc: When advertising executive Jim Blandings discovers his wife's plan to redecorate their New York apartment, he counters with a proposal that they move to Connecticut. She agrees, and the two are soon conned into buying a house that turns out to be a complete nightmare. Construction and repair bills accumulate quickly, and Jim worries that their future hangs in the balance unless he can come up with a catchy new jingle that will sell ham.

programme.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
programme.desc: Artist playboy Dickie Nugent (Cary Grant) appears before beautiful judge Margaret Turner (Myrna Loy) for fighting at a nightclub, and charms her into dismissing the charge. That same day, Dickie happens to lecture at a high school, where Margaret's teenage sister, Susan (Shirley Temple), falls head-over-heels for him. Things get complicated when Susan sneaks away and is found in Dickie's apartment, and downright zany when he is court ordered to date the teen as a way of easing her attraction.

programme.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
programme.desc: Uninterested in an office romance, successful fashion journalist Margot Sherwood Merrick (Myrna Loy) goes to great lengths to conceal the fact that she's single. To ward off potential beaus, including painter Jeff Thompson (Melvyn Douglas), she wears a fake wedding ring and tells everyone she already has a husband. When Jeff realizes that Margot doesn't have a spouse, he decides to make her pay for her deception by posing as her husband, leading to a comical rivalry and a surprising romance.

programme.title: So Goes My Love
programme.desc: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn.

programme.title: A Successful Calamity

In a ploy to keep everyone together, Wilton lies about his wealth and announces he's financially ruined. As expected, his family rallies to support his supposed losses, but how long can he keep the charade up?

programme.title: Turn Back the Clock
programme.desc: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife.

Disguising himself and using the alias "Charles Miller," James begins a partnership with a young bootstrapper named Bill Merrick (David Manners). Complications arise when James' spoiled daughter, Barbara (Evalyn Knapp), becomes a regular customer and competition from a neighboring gas station threatens to ruin the business.

On the job, he falls for Alexander's beautiful daughter, Maura (Laraine Day). Facing dangerous conditions and serious design challenges, Munroe struggles to complete the job he was hired to do, while simultaneously struggling to convince his skeptical, overprotective employer that he is a worthy suitor for Maura.

When Martin's silver mine strikes it rich, he begins to live the high life, moving to a huge mansion and running for public office. His grandiose ways alienate his wife, however, so he takes up with Lily (Bebe Daniels). Then Martin begins dreaming of running for national office, unaware that his fate will change once again.

programme.title: The World Changes

These wildcatters team up with a local drilling equipment owner, Luther Aldrich (Frank Morgan), and strike it rich -- but the ups and downs of the oil business, the whims of South American politics, and the love of Elizabeth Betsy Bartlett (Claudette Colbert) threaten to tear the two friends apart.

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage

As the veteran and the maid begin to learn more about one another, they see past their outer imperfections to discover that true beauty lies within.

Then Paul, injured but still very much alive, sends word that he is coming to reunite with his wife, putting a damper on Jean's plans to start a new life with Marise.

Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer.

programme.title: Random Harvest

While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband.

After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon.

programme.title: Sinners
programme.desc: Hoping to escape their troubled pasts, twin brothers return to their hometown to start over, only to find an even darker force waiting to welcome them back. Writer/director Ryan Coogler's Oscar-winning horror thriller, starring Michael B Jordan, Miles Caton and Saul Williams.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: A crook and his unhinged brother take a preacher's family hostage and cross the border into Mexico. They head to a rough strip club to make a planned rendezvous with a third party - but they soon have to live on their wits when they realise that the establishment's staff are vampires. Horror, starring George Clooney, Harvey Keitel, Quentin Tarantino, Juliette Lewis and Salma Hayek.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

programme.desc: A young couple flee the city during a zombie outbreak, only to be involved in a car crash. When the man awakes, his girlfriend is missing, so he bands together with a rugged survivalist to find his partner - but he only has selected memories of what he has been through. Apocalypse drama, starring Carrie-Anne Moss, Douglas Smith, Frank Grillo and Kimberley-Sue Murray.

programme.title: Presence

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams.

En 100 ans, les agriculteurs ont vu se refaçonner leur métier : ils sont passés de la charrue au tracteur commandé par GPS, du fumier aux pesticides puis au bio, ils ont dû mécaniser leur exploitation, et produire toujours plus dans une logique industrielle. La France comptait plus de 2 millions de fermes avant-guerre, il y en a moins de 400 000 aujourd’hui. « Familles de paysans » retrace 100 ans de la grande histoire agricole à travers le destin et les souvenirs de six familles d’agriculteurs.

programme.title: La roue de la fortune
programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

programme.title: La meilleure cuisine régionale, c'est chez moi !
programme.desc: De la Bretagne au Grand Est, des Hauts-de-France à la Provence, des dizaines de restaurateurs bien décidés à faire briller leur région vont accueillir chez eux les chefs Norbert Tarayre et Yoann Conte ! Leur but : partager et faire découvrir la plus typique, la plus gourmande, la plus authentique des spécialités locales afin de remporter le titre de meilleur restaurant de leur région. Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

programme.title: Scènes de ménages 20h30
programme.desc: Votre couple vous désole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Ménages va vous aider à relativiser !

Un couple tente de rénover seul sa maison pour y célébrer son mariage, mais accumule les catastrophes domestiques. Sue est victime d'un AVC et choisit Maddie pour assurer son intérim à la tête du centre d'appels, ce qui crée des tensions avec Josh. May, en pleine réflexion sur son avenir, remet en question son projet de devenir avocate. Buck refuse de parler du traumatisme de son enlèvement.

Un homme se présente au commissariat en affirmant avoir été assassiné avant de s'effondrer. Athena enquête sur cet empoisonnement lié à un journaliste d'investigation. Buck lutte en secret contre une dépendance aux opioïdes après son accident. La 118 se précipite sur les lieux d'un accident de voiture impliquant une mère et son fils.

L’unité 118 se mobilise lorsqu'un accident de poids lourd transportant des millions d'abeilles tueuses entraîne la libération d’un essaim géant dans les rues de Los Angeles, qui sème la panique et s’attaque aux habitants.

Athena est chargée d'escorter en avion Dennis Jenkins, un prisonnier qui doit témoigner dans une affaire très médiatisée. Le vol tourne à la catastrophe lorsque l’appareil est percuté en plein vol par un avion de tourisme et que le commandant de bord disparaît dans les airs...

Athena est chargée d'escorter en avion Dennis Jenkins, un prisonnier qui doit témoigner dans une affaire très médiatisée. Le vol tourne à la catastrophe lorsque l’appareil est percuté en plein vol par un avion de tourisme et que le commandant de bord disparaît dans les airs...

Athena tente l'impossible pour sauver tous les passagers de l'avion. Elle doit impérativement faire atterrir l'avion avant qu'il ne s'écrase avec l'aide à distance de la tour de contrôle et de la 118 au sol.

programme.sub-title: S8 E4 - La chasse aux tigres
programme.desc: Lorsque Hen et Karen semblent enfin pouvoir récupérer leur agrément de famille d'accueil, elles se heurtent à un nouvel obstacle. La 118 se porte au secours d'un cheerleader victime d’un choc sur le terrain.

programme.title: La France a un incroyable talent
programme.desc:
Pour la première fois de son histoire, La France a un incroyable talent s’associe à TikTok pour une soirée d’auditions exceptionnelle.
Le temps d’une émission, les créateurs de contenu quittent leur feed pour monter sur la scène. Repérés sur TikTok pour leur créativité, leur univers et leur capacité à rassembler des communautés, ils viennent relever un tout nouveau défi : convaincre le jury en quelques minutes, loin des écrans de smartphone.
Mais une communauté de millions d’abonnés ne garantit pas une place dans la compétition. Comme tous les autres candidats, ils devront obtenir au moins trois « oui » pour poursuivre l’aventure et prouver qu’ils peuvent transformer leur succès numérique en véritable performance de scène.
Chant, danse, humour, performances visuelles ou disciplines totalement inédites… TikTok débarque sur la scène de La France a un incroyable talent avec une nouvelle génération de talents !

programme.title: Wanted : attrape-moi si tu peux !
programme.desc: Dans un lieu tenu secret, 16 célébrités seront « enfermées » dans une « prison », sous la surveillance de trois autres célébrités (Michou, Issa Doumbia, Adil Rami) qui seront leurs gardiens, avec un sens de la provocation et de l’humour qui promet déjà quelques grands moments ! Mais lorsque les portes des cellules s’ouvriront, ce sera le départ du plus grand jeu de poursuite jamais organisé en France !\r\nPendant quatre jours, les 16 célébrités, devenues les « fugitifs » devront tout faire pour ne pas se faire attraper par les trois célébrités « gardiens ». Privés d’argent, de téléphone et de tous leurs repères, les « fugitifs » devront se déplacer, se nourrir, se cacher et « survivre ». Dans une ambiance aussi fun que survoltée, « les gardiens » pourront compter sur un véhicule équipé de tous les outils technologiques mais aussi, et surtout… de vous ! Car pour la première fois en France, les téléspectateurs deviennent acteurs du jeu, en choisissant, via un numéro dédié, d’aider les gardiens… ou de protéger les fugitifs.

programme.title: Patron incognito
programme.sub-title: Georges Elkouby, président Europe de Isotoner (1/2)
programme.desc: C’est une marque qui nous chausse, nous gante et nous protège de la pluie depuis plus d’une centaine d’années qui tente l’expérience Patron Incognito : lsotoner. \r\nIsotoner est aujourd’hui la 4e marque en France en volume de chaussures vendues, derrière Nike, Adidas et Puma. Son dirigeant, Georges Elkouby, a intégré Isotoner dans le milieu des années 90, alors que l’entreprise opère un tournant stratégique dans son circuit de distribution. Rien ne prédestinait Georges à diriger un jour une entreprise de cette ampleur. C’est dans un quartier populaire de la capitale que le patron a grandi, dans une famille modeste et entouré de ses 6 frères et sœurs. \r\nAujourd’hui l’entreprise souhaite rajeunir et moderniser son image. Un gros challenge qui pousse Georges Elkouby à retourner sur le terrain en mode incognito pour observer son entreprise sous un angle radicalement différent.

programme.desc: Des candidats vont tenter leur chance pour dénicher les mots et expressions cachés, tout en espérant décrocher les plus gros gains offerts par la roue de la fortune. Mais attention, ils devront éviter la redoutable banqueroute et les autres pièges qu’elle réserve. Chaque jour, trois candidats s'affrontent à travers cinq manches, durant lesquelles ils doivent résoudre une énigme en découvrant un mot ou des expressions. Trouver une consonne leur rapporte de l'argent, tandis que les voyelles sont payantes. À la fin de la cinquième manche, celui ayant amassé le plus d'argent accède à la finale, ce qui lui offre le droit de revenir le lendemain. Lors de la finale, il peut remporter jusqu'à 20 000 euros ou un voyage, à condition de résoudre une ultime énigme en seulement 10 secondes !

Une compétition faites de secrets culinaires, d’astuces incroyables, de folklore et d’émotion auprès de ceux qui font vivre l’identité gastronomique de nos régions !

De sa conception à son installation en vitrine à Paris, en passant par la Normandie où elle puise son inspiration, coup de projecteur sur l'une de ses délicates créations de Noël.

programme.title: Démo de mode

programme.title: Tendance XXI

programme.title: Ça commence aujourd'hui

programme.title: Vestiaires

programme.title: Fauchées

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: Une vidéo sur les réseaux sociaux attire l'attention de la police. On y voit deux jeunes femmes dans un hôtel abandonné, tentant de fuir, clairement menacées.

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: La brigade va investir bien des lieux inexplorés de La Réunion. Pendant ce temps, une nouvelle recrue intègre l'effectif. C'est la panique quand elle disparaît.

Découverte du jour : le fachon aux blettes.

programme.title: Littoral

programme.title: Mise au point

programme.desc: Saïd confie à Socrate et Vanessa le marché qu'il a passé avec Rachid El Hassani : il a trois jours pour retrouver son neveu. Il n'en informe pas Badri.

programme.title: Chats et chiens sauvages
programme.desc: En Australie et en Afrique, les canidés sauvages sont de redoutables prédateurs qui n'hésitent pas à s'attaquer à des proies bien plus imposantes qu'eux.

Il nous confie l'estimation qu'il en fait et ce qu'il rêve d'accomplir avec cette somme. Rendez-vous ensuite chez un commissaire-priseur, dont le verdict expert réserve parfois de cruelles désillusions… ou de belles surprises !!

programme.title: The Rookie : le flic de Los Angeles

programme.title: MMA : UFC
programme.desc: Le combat principal de l'UFC Fight Night 291 oppose les prétendants des poids welters Joaquin Buckley et Mike Malott. Ce choc en cinq rounds, à la Rogers Place d'Edmonton, est crucial pour le top 10 de la catégorie des -77 kg. Mike Malott évoluera à domicile. Le chouchou du public canadien surfe sur une dynamique exceptionnelle de quatre victoires consécutives. De son côté, Joaquin Buckley se déplace en territoire ennemi, avec la ferme intention de stopper l'ascension du Canadien.

programme.title: MMA : Cage Warriors
programme.desc: Cage Warriors 211 se déroule au PalaPellicone de Rome, en Italie. Cette soirée marque le retour officiel de l'organisation européenne d'arts martiaux mixtes sur le sol italien, mettant en avant une carte particulièrement riche en talents locaux. Le programme propose un total de 15 combats. L'affiche principale, chez les poids moyens, oppose l'Italien Dario Bellandi au Brésilien Renato Valente. programme.desc: Bilel Jkitou est l'invité de l'émission "Baba Versus", animée par Baba Diagne. Le boxeur professionnel franco-marocain se livre lors d'un entretien de fond sur les coulisses de sa carrière. Il y aborde notamment la gestion de la pression et les sacrifices inhérents au sport de haut niveau, sa mentalité face aux doutes et la discipline nécessaire pour atteindre les sommets. Il évoque enfin sn actualité sportive, marquée par un combat majeur pour la ceinture mondiale IBA.

programme.title: MMA : Countdown UFC
programme.desc: L'UFC 333 se déroulera le samedi 24 octobre 2026 à l'Etihad Arena d'Abu Dhabi. Lors de cette soirée, le roi des poids plumes, l'Australien Alexander Volkanovski (28-4), défendra son trône face au Russe invaincu Movsar Evloev. En Co-Main Event, le poids coq russe Petr Yan affrontera le Géorgien Merab Dvalishvili. Dvalishvili avait remporté leur premier duel en 2023, mais Petr Yan avait pris sa revanche en décembre 2025, lors de l'UFC 323 pour redevenir champion. Ce troisième affrontement scellera définitivement le sort de leur rivalité.

programme.title: MMA : KSW
programme.desc: Le gala KSW 122 se déroule à la Hala Podpromie de Rzeszow, en Pologne. En poids légers, le Polonais Marian Ziolkowski affronte le Français Wilson Varela. Ce dernier, champion des -70 kg d'Hexagone MMA, fait son retour très attendu au KSW pour confirmer sa suprématie face à l'ancien champion polonais de la catégorie. Les deux combattants se sont déjà affrontés en avril 2024 lors d'un combat marquant où Wilson Varela s'était imposé par TKO au deuxième round, après une blessure à l'épaule de Ziolkowski.

programme.title: Divorce Club

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Après l'attaque d'une mission humanitaire au Soudan du Sud, un médecin de la Marine et le mari de Jeanne Benoit disparaissent. McGee, Tony et Jeanne partent sur place pour les retrouver, tandis que Gibbs reste à Washington, toujours affaibli par son opération.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Libéré du couloir de la mort pour vice de procédure, un jeune Marine demande au NCIS de l'arrêter afin de démontrer qu'il est innocent du meurtre de son ex-petite amie. De son côté, Bishop surprend son mari avec une collègue des affaires internes et redoute qu'il ait des ennuis avec la NSA.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S13 E10 - Le don de soi
programme.desc: La Secrétaire de la Navy charge le NCIS de retrouver le dernier enfant d'une fratrie militaire. Deux d'entre eux sont morts en service, tandis qu'un troisième attend une greffe vitale. À quelques jours de Thanksgiving, Bishop, réfugiée dans sa famille après l'infidélité de son mari, prend part à l'enquête.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S13 E11 - Jusqu'au bout du monde
programme.desc: Ducky est agressé par un homme qui cherche son demi-frère, Nicholas Mallard, disparu depuis des décennies et que le médecin légiste croyait mort. Tandis que le NCIS traque le suspect, Ducky replonge dans ses souvenirs et revient sur les derniers instants passés avec ce frère qu'il n'a jamais cessé de chercher.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.sub-title: S13 E12 - L'union fait la force
programme.desc: Un jet privé reliant La Nouvelle-Orléans à Washington cesse de répondre. À son atterrissage forcé, les cinq passagers sont retrouvés morts. Dwayne Pride apprend alors à Gibbs que Luca Sciuto, le frère d'Abby, faisait partie des victimes. Employé comme cuisinier dans une société liée à des technologies militaires, il pourrait être au cœur de l'affaire.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'épouse et la maîtresse d'un Marine s'accusent mutuellement de son meurtre, obligeant le NCIS à découvrir laquelle ment. De son côté, Anthony DiNozzo Sr. est abordé par une jeune sans-abri persuadée qu'il est son père. Avec l'aide de Tony, il cherche à percer le mystère de son identité.

programme.title: Les apprentis aventuriers
programme.desc: Sacs de 25 kg, insectes et statuette à maintenir en équilibre : la pyramide de la résistance teste les limites des candidats. Au retour, Emi et Anthony s’expliquent sur leur épreuve, qui met leur avenir en jeu.

programme.title: Mylène Farmer - Nevermore 2023/2024
programme.desc: Découvrez « Nevermore 2023/2024 », le concert événement de Mylène Farmer. Avec 14 stades rapidement complets et plus de 600 000 spectateurs, cette tournée est la plus importante jamais proposée en France par une artiste. Retrouvez ses titres emblématiques, de « Sans contrefaçon » à « Désenchantée », dans un spectacle grandiose porté par des décors impressionnants et des chorégraphies iconiques.

programme.title: Mylène Farmer, sans contrefaçon
programme.desc: Mylène Farmer reste l’une des chanteuses françaises les plus mystérieuses. Icône pour plusieurs générations, elle captive le public avec des concerts spectaculaires, conçus comme de véritables shows à l’américaine.\r\nAvec de nombreux disques de diamant à son actif, elle détient aussi le record du nombre de singles classés numéro un au Top 50, avec 13 titres. À travers les étapes clés de sa carrière, découvrez comment cette artiste hors norme est devenue une star incontournable.\r\nComment a-t-elle construit son univers ? Pourquoi est-elle si rare à la télévision ? Et pourquoi a-t-elle parfois envisagé d’arrêter la chanson ?

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.sub-title: Affaire Travaglini : issue fatale pour un ménage à trois (1/2)
programme.desc:
À 28 ans, Jessy Travaglini avait un nom et un physique de star hollywoodienne. Sublime, intelligente, la jeune mère de famille, épouse d’un entraineur de rugby respecté dans la région de Carpentras, avait tout pour réussir sa vie. Rien ne pouvait laisser penser que cette chargée des ressources humaines, se retrouve un jour dans le box d’une cour d’assises. Et pourtant, la belle est accusée d’un crime terrible : l’assassinat d’une autre mère de famille, Éloïse Bagnolini, 30 ans.
La disparition d’Éloïse est signalée le 11 octobre 2013 par son mari, Alain Castel. Ce jour-là, sa compagne l'avertit par texto qu’exceptionnellement elle ne pourra pas récupérer leur enfant à l'école. Inquiet, en rentrant chez lui à Aubignan, Alain découvre leur domicile en désordre mais aucune trace d’Éloïse. Ses affaires et sa voiture aussi ont disparu. La jeune mère au foyer semble avoir fait ses valises…
Pour le compagnon d’Éloïse, c’est l’incompréhension : le couple semblait nager en plein bonheur, et surtout Éloïse ne serait jamais partie sans son petit garçon de 3 ans. D’ailleurs, les premières constatations des gendarmes dessinent un autre scénario, bien plus sombre celui-ci : du sang d’Éloïse macule le sol, le pommeau de douche est cassé. Ce départ précipité et volontaire serait en fait un crime maquillé… Qui pouvait en vouloir à Éloïse Bagnolini ? A-t-elle été enlevée ? Où est-elle ?
Pour les gendarmes, l’affaire va prendre des allures de crime passionnel car le veuf éploré n’a pas tout dit. Alain, cadre supérieur, entretenait une relation extraconjugale avec une collègue de travail, Jessy Travaglini. Le mari volage serait même devenu son mentor et l’aurait aidée à gravir rapidement les échelons. Coïncidence troublante, le jour de la disparition d’Éloïse, Jessy Travaglini a posé un jour de congé…
La jeune femme serait-elle une croqueuse d’hommes, ambitieuse, "qui ne supporterait pas la concurrence" comme la décrivent ses collègues de travail ? Aurait-elle éliminé sa rivale ? Interpellée, la maîtresse va faire des révélations fracassantes aux enquêteurs : oui, c’est bien elle qui a tué la compagne de son amant… Mais elle aurait agi en état de légitime défense. En fait, c’est Éloïse qui, le matin du drame, alors qu’elle venait de découvrir que son conjoint la trompait, aurait donné rendez-vous à Jessy à son domicile pour régler ses comptes. Agressée violemment, dans la bagarre, Jessy Travaglini aurait accidentellement ôté la vie de la mère de famille. Puis, prise de panique, elle se serait débarrassée du corps en l’enfermant dans le coffre de sa voiture. Éloïse était-elle au courant de la liaison de son mari avec sa collègue ? Alain avait-il mis un terme à sa relation extraconjugale comme il le prétend ? La maîtresse de 53 kilos pour 1m70 a-t-elle pu agir seule ? 
Les gendarmes ne vont pas tarder à découvrir que dans cette affaire, Jessy Travaglini et son amant jouent avec la vérité comme un chat joue avec une souris…

Dans la deuxième partie de l'émission : l'affaire Angélique Six. En 2018, la France est sous le choc : Angélique, 12 ans, a été violée et étranglée à Quesnoy-sur-Deûle, près de Lille. L’émotion est telle que le champion de football Neymar, l’idole d’Angélique, va écrire à la famille. Les policiers enchaînent les fausses pistes mais un témoignage capital va tout relancer : Kilian, 10 ans, aurait vu Angélique avec un homme dans le parc près de son domicile, le jour de sa disparition. Qui est ce mystérieux individu qui accompagnait la jeune adolescente ?

programme.title: Enquêtes criminelles
programme.desc:
Depuis le 6 décembre 2016, Vanessa Melet, 37 ans, a disparu sans laisser de trace. Ce matin-là pourtant, en sortant du domicile de ses parents vers 7h30, elle avait lancé à sa mère : « Je vais faire un tour, je reviens… ». Alors, qu’est-il arrivé à cette conseillère bancaire de Langrune-sur-Mer dans le Calvados ?
Pour les parents de la jeune femme, impossible d’envisager une disparition volontaire ou un suicide. Ils sont persuadés qu’un homme est derrière tout cela. Un homme qui aurait profité de sa vulnérabilité pour lui faire du mal. En effet, plusieurs semaines avant sa disparition, Vanessa était revenue vivre chez ses parents en raison d’un sérieux problème de santé : une terrible douleur aux hanches qu’aucun médecin traditionnel ne parvient à guérir. Se déplaçant de plus en plus difficilement, la jolie célibataire délaisse les sites de rencontre pour les forums de santé et se tourne vers des médecines alternatives. Et l’un des soignants qu’elle a consultés intrigue tout particulièrement ses proches. Le médecin dans le collimateur des parents de Vanessa Melet est psychothérapeute, hypnotiseur. Fait troublant : un jour, alors que la jeune femme et sa mère sortent d’un rendez-vous médical, elles aperçoivent l’homme dans sa voiture en train de les observer. Que fait-il ici ? Son cabinet médical est à l’autre bout de la ville… Et ce n’est pas tout : pourquoi les relevés téléphoniques de Vanessa indiquent qu’ils ont échangé à quatre reprises la veille de sa disparition ? Pour Enquêtes criminelles, la mère de Vanessa Melet raconte son combat pour connaître la vérité. 

Dans la seconde partie de l’émission, Enquêtes criminelles s’intéressera à une autre disparition mystérieuse. Betting, en Moselle, le 7 mars 2020. Il est 2h30 quand Anthony Muroni est retrouvé grièvement blessé, allongé en plein milieu des voies sur l’autoroute A4. Il décédera quelques heures plus tard. Pour les parents du jeune homme, il ne s’agit pas d’un accident, encore moins d’un suicide. Et ils sont persuadés que des personnes très proches d’Anthony savent ce qui s’est passé.

programme.desc: Ve siècle, île de Bretagne. Le royaume de Kaamelott s'organise autour de son souverain, le roi Arthur. Entouré de ses fidèles chevaliers de la Table Ronde, il s'attelle à la mission que les dieux lui ont confiée : rechercher le Saint Graal !

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: En enquêtant sur le meurtre d'un biochimiste de la Navy, Abby se rend dans un laboratoire pharmaceutique. Mais des hommes armés prennent le contrôle des lieux, déclenchent le confinement et menacent d'exécuter les otages.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'un officier porte la signature du « sniper des 3 États ». Mais lorsqu'un homme ayant avoué les six précédents crimes est arrêté avant ce nouveau meurtre, le NCIS comprend qu'un imitateur est à l'œuvre. En parallèle, McGee et Delilah apprennent à faire des compromis avant leur emménagement.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'un Marine retraité pousse Ducky à révéler à Gibbs qu'il appartient au « consortium Sherlock Holmes », un club de détectives amateurs. La victime leur avait demandé de prouver l'innocence de son fils, condamné à perpétuité après un test ADN réalisé par Abby.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Après l'attaque d'une mission humanitaire au Soudan du Sud, un médecin de la Marine et le mari de Jeanne Benoit disparaissent. McGee, Tony et Jeanne partent sur place pour les retrouver, tandis que Gibbs reste à Washington, toujours affaibli par son opération.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Libéré du couloir de la mort pour vice de procédure, un jeune Marine demande au NCIS de l'arrêter afin de démontrer qu'il est innocent du meurtre de son ex-petite amie. De son côté, Bishop surprend son mari avec une collègue des affaires internes et redoute qu'il ait des ennuis avec la NSA.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Une gardienne de prison britannique est retrouvée morte dans un conteneur arrivé d'Angleterre. Les premiers éléments indiquent qu'elle a été prise en otage par deux évadés, dont un ancien espion du MI6 autrefois arrêté par le NCIS.

programme.title: Les apprentis aventuriers
programme.desc: Laurent dévoile la Vallée des Perles et sa perle d’or, qui offre un accès direct à la finale. Avant d’espérer l’explorer, les binômes doivent se qualifier pour l’expédition : propulser, rattraper puis lancer des sacs demande une coordination sans faille.
